Kenji: Heads-up — nightly perf dashboard alert at 02:13 UTC: p95 token latency +2.5x on main-merge hosts. Link: https://dash/redwood/nightly/5301239876 :eyes:
perfbot: alert posted: latency_spike_kernel_selector
Aisha: seeing same. p95 130ms -> 340ms on merge pool, throughput down ~30%.
Liam: any recent merges? I see a topple at ~01:45 — merge 8a3f2b (batching heuristics) and 8a3f9c (kernel-prober)...
Priya: CI perf run for that PR failed earlier? Jenkins: ci-runtime-perf/456 — flakes around kernel selection timings.
Marco: grabbing flamegraphs now, attaching top lines.
Kenji: paste flamegraph snippet:
```
kernel_select+0x1a  48.3%
kernel_dispatch+0x3b  22.1%
kv_cache_lookup+0x10  15.6%
batch_coalesce+0x07  8.9%
```
Aisha: kv cache miss rate spiked from 5% -> 22% around the same time. Could be a tag collision with new cache key normalization.
Priya: rollback candidate? If kernel-prober revert helps we should canary.
Liam: quick bisect suggestion: `git bisect start -- bad main@HEAD good main@{2026-03-15}` then checkout ranges for the two merges.
Kenji: I ran a local bisect on our perf harness, narrowed to commit 8a3f9c (kernel-prober ordering). Repro on local-run.
Marco: Can we hotfix with prober flag off? `runtime.flags.enable_kernel_prober=false` — tested on stage and p95 back to 125ms.
perfbot: deploy rollback suggested for canary by ops-runner
Aisha: let's schedule immediate canary rollback and open a revert PR for 8a3f9c. I'll ping @oncall.
Kenji: filing revert PR: https://git/repo/pull/789 — description + perf regression bench.
Priya: also adding KV cache diagnostic logs to nightly (dump kv-hints every 5m) so we can confirm root cause.
Liam: good. After revert canary, re-run CI perf job and post results here.
Kenji: noted. tagging @ops and @sre. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Marco: thanks everyone. keeping thread for updates.
